ψαλτῳδέω.shortDefinition: to sing to strings, sing psalms

ψαύω.shortDefinition: to touch lightly, lay hands on

ψευδάδελφος.shortDefinition: a false brother; fig. a false Christian/Believer

ψευδομαρτυρέω.shortDefinition: to testify falsely, bear false witness

ψηφίζω.shortDefinition: to calculate, compute; lit. to count with pebbles

ψιθυρίζω.shortDefinition: to whisper; fig. to whisper against, gossip

ψιθυρισμός.shortDefinition: a whispering; fig. a gossip, slander

ψιθυριστής.shortDefinition: a whisperer; fig. a gossip, slanderer

ψίθυρος.shortDefinition: to be whispering; fig. to be backbiting

ψοφέω.shortDefinition: to make a noise, stamp (the foot)

ψυχή.shortDefinition: a gentle breath; fig. a light breeze, life-breath, living creature, soul

ψυχικός.shortDefinition: to be of the soul, natural; fig. to be unspiritual

ψυχουλκέομαι.shortDefinition: to gasp for life, breathe one’s last

ψωμίζω.shortDefinition: to feed (with morsels), give as food

ψωμίον.shortDefinition: a little morsel, bit (of bread); trad. a sop
